fr.title: 6-3 et une base de données sur la citoyenneté : pourquoi la Cour suprême a autorisé le système SAVE à continuer de vérifier les listes électorales quelques semaines avant les élections de mi-mandat

segments.src: On September 25, 2026, the Supreme Court granted an emergency request from the Justice Department and paused a lower-court order that had blocked the administration's overhauled SAVE system.
segments.tr: Le 25 septembre 2026, la Cour suprême a accédé à une demande d'urgence du ministère de la Justice et a suspendu une ordonnance d'un tribunal inférieur qui avait bloqué le système SAVE remanié de l'administration.

segments.src: The vote was 6-3.
segments.tr: Le vote a été de 6 contre 3.

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3, less than six weeks away, the order lets federal agencies keep sharing citizenship data with state and local election officials who want to verify their voter lists.
segments.tr: Alors que le jour des élections est fixé au 3 novembre, dans moins de six semaines, l'ordonnance permet aux agences fédérales de continuer à partager les données de citoyenneté avec les responsables électoraux des États et des collectivités locales qui souhaitent vérifier leurs listes électorales.

segments.src: The order is temporary and does not end the case.
segments.tr: L'ordonnance est temporaire et ne met pas fin à l'affaire.

segments.src: Even so, it settles for now a question that has drawn attention from election officials, privacy advocates, and voting-rights groups: how far the federal government can go in helping states check who is a citizen.
segments.tr: Même ainsi, elle règle pour l'instant une question qui a attiré l'attention des responsables électoraux, des défenseurs de la vie privée et des groupes de défense du droit de vote : jusqu'où le gouvernement fédéral peut-il aller pour aider les États à vérifier qui est citoyen.

segments.src: ## What SAVE Is and What Changed
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'est SAVE et ce qui a changé

segments.src: SAVE stands for Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements.
segments.tr: SAVE signifie Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements (Vérification systématique des étrangers pour les prestations).

segments.src: It is a federal data system that dates back to the 1980s.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'un système de données fédéral qui remonte aux années 1980.

segments.src: Government agencies originally used it to confirm the immigration status of people applying for public benefits or licenses.
segments.tr: Les agences gouvernementales l'utilisaient à l'origine pour confirmer le statut d'immigration des personnes demandant des prestations publiques ou des licences.

segments.src: According to news reports, the Department of Homeland Security overhauled the system in 2025.
segments.tr: Selon les reportages, le département de la Sécurité intérieure a remanié le système en 2025.

segments.src: The changes:
segments.tr: Les changements :

segments.src: - **Broader data.** SAVE was linked for the first time with Social Security Administration records, which cover most Americans and not only noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Données plus larges.** SAVE a été lié pour la première fois aux dossiers de la Social Security Administration (Administration de la sécurité sociale), qui couvrent la plupart des Américains et pas seulement les non-citoyens.

segments.src: - **Bulk searches.** States and localities can upload entire voter lists instead of checking one person at a time.
segments.tr: - **Recherches en masse.** Les États et les localités peuvent télécharger des listes électorales entières au lieu de vérifier une personne à la fois.

segments.src: - **A new use.** Election officials can run registered voters through the system to look for possible noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Une nouvelle utilisation.** Les responsables électoraux peuvent faire passer les électeurs inscrits dans le système pour rechercher d'éventuels non-citoyens.

segments.src: NPR reported that 26 states had uploaded voter data and that the system had checked more than 65 million voters.
segments.tr: NPR a rapporté que 26 États avaient téléchargé des données électorales et que le système avait vérifié plus de 65 millions d'électeurs.

segments.src: About 28,635 were flagged as potential noncitizens.
segments.tr: Environ 28 635 ont été signalés comme des non-citoyens potentiels.

segments.src: A flag is not a finding.
segments.tr: Un signalement n'est pas une conclusion.

segments.src: It is a lead that officials are expected to follow up, and in Texas, roughly one in five of 2,724 flagged voters was later confirmed to be a citizen and reinstated, according to the same reporting.
segments.tr: C'est une piste que les responsables sont censés suivre, et au Texas, environ un électeur sur cinq parmi les 2 724 signalés a été confirmé plus tard comme étant citoyen et réintégré, selon le même reportage.

segments.src: The government has not publicly released an overall error rate.
segments.tr: Le gouvernement n'a pas publié publiquement de taux d'erreur global.

segments.src: ## How the Case Got to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## Comment l'affaire est arrivée devant la Cour suprême

segments.src: The League of Women Voters, the Electronic Privacy Information Center, and five individuals sued the Department of Homeland Security, the Social Security Administration, and the Department of Justice.
segments.tr: La League of Women Voters, l'Electronic Privacy Information Center et cinq particuliers ont poursuivi le département de la Sécurité intérieure, la Social Security Administration et le ministère de la Justice.

segments.src: They argued that combining and sharing sensitive personal records this way broke federal law.
segments.tr: Ils ont fait valoir que la combinaison et le partage de dossiers personnels sensibles de cette manière violaient la loi fédérale.

segments.src: In June 2026, U.S.
segments.tr: En juin 2026, le juge de district américain

segments.src: District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan agreed.
segments.tr: Sparkle Sooknanan a donné raison aux plaignants.

segments.src: She found that the aggregation and disclosure of the data violated the Social Security Act, the Privacy Act, and the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: Elle a conclu que l'agrégation et la divulgation des données violaient la loi sur la sécurité sociale (Social Security Act), la loi sur la protection de la vie privée (Privacy Act) et la loi sur la procédure administrative (Administrative Procedure Act).

segments.src: She wrote that the government had "knowingly trampled on the privacy rights of American citizens in a manner that threatens the sacred right to vote," and she blocked the revised system.
segments.tr: Elle a écrit que le gouvernement avait « sciemment piétiné les droits à la vie privée des citoyens américains d'une manière qui menace le droit sacré de voter », et elle a bloqué le système révisé.

segments.src: The administration asked the Supreme Court to stay that order while the case continued.
segments.tr: L'administration a demandé à la Cour suprême de suspendre cette ordonnance pendant que l'affaire suivait son cours.

segments.src: ## Why the Majority Let SAVE Continue
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la majorité a laissé SAVE continuer

segments.src: The Court's unsigned order said the voting-rights groups' claims about the legality of the modified system "likely lack merit," and that the Court was likely to reverse the district court's ruling.
segments.tr: L'ordonnance non signée de la Cour a déclaré que les affirmations des groupes de défense du droit de vote concernant la légalité du système modifié « manquent probablement de fondement » et que la Cour était susceptible d'annuler la décision du tribunal de district.

segments.src: It also said the federal government "has an obligation to respond to requests from state and local election officials seeking to verify the citizenship of voters."
segments.tr: Elle a également déclaré que le gouvernement fédéral « a l'obligation de répondre aux demandes des responsables électoraux des États et des collectivités locales cherchant à vérifier la citoyenneté des électeurs ».

segments.src: Reporting on the order highlights two more points:
segments.tr: Les reportages sur l'ordonnance mettent en évidence deux points supplémentaires :

segments.src: 1. **Individualized checks.** The majority stressed the use of SAVE to check individual voters' citizenship as the election approaches.
segments.tr: 1. **Vérifications individualisées.** La majorité a insisté sur l'utilisation de SAVE pour vérifier la citoyenneté des électeurs individuels à l'approche de l'élection.

segments.src: 2. **The 90-day rule.** Federal law generally bars systematic programs to remove voters from the rolls within 90 days of a federal election. That window is already open for the midterms. Reporters noted that this limits how the tool can be used before November.
segments.tr: 2. **La règle des 90 jours.** La loi fédérale interdit généralement les programmes systématiques visant à retirer des électeurs des listes dans les 90 jours précédant une élection fédérale. Cette fenêtre est déjà ouverte pour les élections de mi-mandat. Les journalistes ont noté que cela limite la façon dont l'outil peut être utilisé avant novembre.

segments.src: In short, the majority signaled that officials may verify specific voters but should not run large-scale purges this close to the election.
segments.tr: En bref, la majorité a signalé que les responsables peuvent vérifier des électeurs spécifiques mais ne devraient pas procéder à des purges à grande échelle si près de l'élection.

segments.src: ## Jackson's Dissent
segments.tr: ## L'opinion dissidente de Jackson

segments.src: Justices Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, and Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented.
segments.tr: Les juges Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan et Ketanji Brown Jackson ont exprimé leur désaccord.

segments.src: Jackson wrote the dissent.
segments.tr: Jackson a rédigé l'opinion dissidente.

segments.src: She faulted the majority for not weighing the harms that could follow if the modified system keeps operating.
segments.tr: Elle a reproché à la majorité de ne pas avoir pesé les préjudices qui pourraient survenir si le système modifié continuait de fonctionner.

segments.src: One risk she named was that states might cancel the registrations of at least some recently naturalized citizens, or make them show proof of citizenship before voting.
segments.tr: L'un des risques qu'elle a mentionnés est que les États pourraient annuler les inscriptions d'au moins certains citoyens récemment naturalisés, ou les obliger à présenter une preuve de citoyenneté avant de voter.

segments.src: Her central argument was about how to weigh the two sides:
segments.tr: Son argument central portait sur la manière de peser les deux parties :

segments.src: > "[T]he harm caused by burdening or disenfranchising even a few lawful voters outweighs the nonexistent harm that the Government experiences when it is prevented from taking an action that it likely lacks the authority to take."
segments.tr: > « [L]e préjudice causé en accablant ou en privant du droit de vote ne serait-ce que quelques électeurs légaux l'emporte sur le préjudice inexistant que subit le gouvernement lorsqu'il est empêché de prendre une mesure pour laquelle il manque probablement d'autorité. »

segments.src: Coverage of the dissent also noted her objection that the Court acted on its emergency docket without full briefing or oral argument.
segments.tr: La couverture de l'opinion dissidente a également noté son objection selon laquelle la Cour a agi sur son rôle d'urgence sans briefing complet ni plaidoirie.

segments.src: ## The Two Sides in Plain Terms
segments.tr: ## Les deux camps en termes simples

segments.src: **Supporters of the decision** say election officials need reliable tools to keep voter rolls accurate.
segments.tr: **Les partisans de la décision** affirment que les responsables électoraux ont besoin d'outils fiables pour maintenir l'exactitude des listes électorales.

segments.src: They say the federal government holds data states cannot easily get elsewhere, and that Congress and the Court have treated accurate rolls as a legitimate goal.
segments.tr: Ils disent que le gouvernement fédéral détient des données que les États ne peuvent pas facilement obtenir ailleurs, et que le Congrès et la Cour ont traité des listes exactes comme un objectif légitime.

segments.src: Noncitizen voting is illegal under federal law, and supporters argue that verification protects public confidence in elections.
segments.tr: Le vote des non-citoyens est illégal en vertu de la loi fédérale, et les partisans soutiennent que la vérification protège la confiance du public dans les élections.

segments.src: **Critics** say the system can wrongly flag eligible voters.
segments.tr: **Les critiques** disent que le système peut signaler à tort des électeurs éligibles.

segments.src: Naturalized citizens, whose records may not match every federal database, are the group most often cited.
segments.tr: Les citoyens naturalisés, dont les dossiers peuvent ne pas correspondre à chaque base de données fédérale, sont le groupe le plus souvent cité.

segments.src: They also worry about privacy when Social Security data is used for a purpose it was not built for, and about mistakes that come too late for a voter to fix before Election Day.
segments.tr: Ils s'inquiètent également de la vie privée lorsque les données de la sécurité sociale sont utilisées à une fin pour laquelle elles n'ont pas été conçues, et des erreurs qui surviennent trop tard pour qu'un électeur puisse les corriger avant le jour des élections.

segments.src: Both concerns are recognized in the order itself.
segments.tr: Les deux préoccupations sont reconnues dans l'ordonnance elle-même.

segments.src: The majority points to the 90-day limit and to individualized review.
segments.tr: La majorité souligne la limite des 90 jours et l'examen individualisé.

segments.src: The dissent points to the risk that errors reach real voters.
segments.tr: L'opinion dissidente souligne le risque que des erreurs touchent de vrais électeurs.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qui se passe ensuite

segments.src: - **The case continues.** A stay pauses the lower court's order but is not a final ruling on the merits. The litigation over the system's legality goes on.
segments.tr: - **L'affaire continue.** Une suspension met en pause l'ordonnance du tribunal inférieur mais n'est pas une décision finale sur le fond. Le litige sur la légalité du système se poursuit.

segments.src: - **State practices will vary.** Each state decides whether and how to use SAVE and what follow-up process applies to flagged voters.
segments.tr: - **Les pratiques des États varieront.** Chaque État décide s'il utilise SAVE et comment, et quel processus de suivi s'applique aux électeurs signalés.

segments.src: - **Timing matters.** With less than six weeks to Election Day, any verification step that leads to a registration problem leaves little time to correct it.
segments.tr: - **Le timing compte.** Avec moins de six semaines avant le jour des élections, toute étape de vérification qui conduit à un problème d'inscription laisse peu de temps pour le corriger.

segments.src: ## What Voters Can Do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les électeurs peuvent faire

segments.src: Nothing in the order changes who is eligible to vote or the basic rules for casting a ballot.
segments.tr: Rien dans l'ordonnance ne change qui est éligible pour voter ou les règles de base pour déposer un bulletin de vote.

segments.src: A few practical steps are worth taking whatever your view of the ruling:
segments.tr: Quelques mesures pratiques valent la peine d'être prises, quel que soit votre point de vue sur la décision :

segments.src: - **Check your registration** on your state or local election office's official website.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez votre inscription** sur le site officiel de votre bureau électoral local ou de l'État.

segments.src: - **Respond promptly** if you receive a notice asking you to confirm your eligibility or citizenship. Keep any documents the notice asks for.
segments.tr: - **Répondez rapidement** si vous recevez un avis vous demandant de confirmer votre éligibilité ou votre citoyenneté. Conservez tous les documents demandés par l'avis.

segments.src: - **Contact your local election office** if you believe your record is wrong. It can explain the correction process and deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Contactez votre bureau électoral local** si vous pensez que votre dossier est erroné. Il peut expliquer le processus de correction et les délais.

segments.src: - **Confirm key dates** for registration, early voting, and mail ballots with official state sources.
segments.tr: - **Confirmez les dates clés** pour l'inscription, le vote anticipé et les bulletins de vote par correspondance auprès des sources officielles de l'État.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The Supreme Court's 6-3 order keeps a revised federal citizenship-verification system running during the final weeks before the midterms.
segments.tr: L'ordonnance 6-3 de la Cour suprême maintient en activité un système fédéral révisé de vérification de la citoyenneté pendant les dernières semaines précédant les élections de mi-mandat.

segments.src: The majority views the legal challenge as unlikely to succeed and stresses individualized checks.
segments.tr: La majorité considère que la contestation juridique a peu de chances de réussir et insiste sur les vérifications individualisées.

segments.src: The dissenters warn that even a small number of wrongly burdened voters is too high a cost.
segments.tr: Les dissidents avertissent que même un petit nombre d'électeurs injustement accablés est un coût trop élevé.

segments.src: The case is not over.
segments.tr: L'affaire n'est pas terminée.

segments.src: In the meantime, voters and election officials will work under the order's limits, including the 90-day rule on systematic removals.
segments.tr: En attendant, les électeurs et les responsables électoraux travailleront sous les limites de l'ordonnance, y compris la règle des 90 jours sur les suppressions systématiques.

pt.title: 6-3 e um banco de dados de cidadania: Por que a Suprema Corte permitiu que o sistema SAVE continuasse verificando as listas de eleitores semanas antes das eleições de meio de mandato

segments.src: On September 25, 2026, the Supreme Court granted an emergency request from the Justice Department and paused a lower-court order that had blocked the administration's overhauled SAVE system.
segments.tr: Em 25 de setembro de 2026, a Suprema Corte atendeu a um pedido de emergência do Departamento de Justiça e suspendeu uma ordem de um tribunal inferior que havia bloqueado o sistema SAVE reformulado do governo.

segments.src: The vote was 6-3.
segments.tr: A votação foi de 6 a 3.

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3, less than six weeks away, the order lets federal agencies keep sharing citizenship data with state and local election officials who want to verify their voter lists.
segments.tr: Com o dia da eleição em 3 de novembro, a menos de seis semanas de distância, a ordem permite que agências federais continuem compartilhando dados de cidadania com autoridades eleitorais estaduais e locais que desejam verificar suas listas de eleitores.

segments.src: The order is temporary and does not end the case.
segments.tr: A ordem é temporária e não encerra o caso.

segments.src: Even so, it settles for now a question that has drawn attention from election officials, privacy advocates, and voting-rights groups: how far the federal government can go in helping states check who is a citizen.
segments.tr: Mesmo assim, ela resolve por enquanto uma questão que chamou a atenção de autoridades eleitorais, defensores da privacidade e grupos de direitos de voto: até onde o governo federal pode ir para ajudar os estados a verificar quem é cidadão.

segments.src: ## What SAVE Is and What Changed
segments.tr: ## O que é o SAVE e o que mudou

segments.src: SAVE stands for Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements.
segments.tr: SAVE significa Verificação Sistemática de Estrangeiros para Benefícios (Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements).

segments.src: It is a federal data system that dates back to the 1980s.
segments.tr: É um sistema de dados federal que remonta à década de 1980.

segments.src: Government agencies originally used it to confirm the immigration status of people applying for public benefits or licenses.
segments.tr: Agências governamentais o utilizavam originalmente para confirmar o status de imigração de pessoas que solicitavam benefícios públicos ou licenças.

segments.src: According to news reports, the Department of Homeland Security overhauled the system in 2025.
segments.tr: De acordo com reportagens, o Departamento de Segurança Interna reformulou o sistema em 2025.

segments.src: The changes:
segments.tr: As mudanças:

segments.src: - **Broader data.** SAVE was linked for the first time with Social Security Administration records, which cover most Americans and not only noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Dados mais amplos.** O SAVE foi vinculado pela primeira vez aos registros da Administração da Previdência Social, que abrangem a maioria dos americanos e não apenas não cidadãos.

segments.src: - **Bulk searches.** States and localities can upload entire voter lists instead of checking one person at a time.
segments.tr: - **Pesquisas em massa.** Estados e localidades podem enviar listas inteiras de eleitores em vez de verificar uma pessoa de cada vez.

segments.src: - **A new use.** Election officials can run registered voters through the system to look for possible noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Um novo uso.** Autoridades eleitorais podem processar eleitores registrados no sistema para procurar possíveis não cidadãos.

segments.src: NPR reported that 26 states had uploaded voter data and that the system had checked more than 65 million voters.
segments.tr: A NPR relatou que 26 estados enviaram dados de eleitores e que o sistema verificou mais de 65 milhões de eleitores.

segments.src: About 28,635 were flagged as potential noncitizens.
segments.tr: Cerca de 28.635 foram sinalizados como potenciais não cidadãos.

segments.src: A flag is not a finding.
segments.tr: Uma sinalização não é uma conclusão.

segments.src: It is a lead that officials are expected to follow up, and in Texas, roughly one in five of 2,724 flagged voters was later confirmed to be a citizen and reinstated, according to the same reporting.
segments.tr: É uma pista que as autoridades devem investigar, e no Texas, aproximadamente um em cada cinco dos 2.724 eleitores sinalizados foi posteriormente confirmado como cidadão e reintegrado, de acordo com a mesma reportagem.

segments.src: The government has not publicly released an overall error rate.
segments.tr: O governo não divulgou publicamente uma taxa geral de erro.

segments.src: ## How the Case Got to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## Como o caso chegou à Suprema Corte

segments.src: The League of Women Voters, the Electronic Privacy Information Center, and five individuals sued the Department of Homeland Security, the Social Security Administration, and the Department of Justice.
segments.tr: A Liga das Mulheres Eleitoras, o Centro de Informações sobre Privacidade Eletrônica e cinco indivíduos processaram o Departamento de Segurança Interna, a Administração da Previdência Social e o Departamento de Justiça.

segments.src: They argued that combining and sharing sensitive personal records this way broke federal law.
segments.tr: Eles argumentaram que combinar e compartilhar registros pessoais sensíveis dessa maneira violava a lei federal.

segments.src: In June 2026, U.S.
segments.tr: Em junho de 2026, a juíza distrital dos EUA

segments.src: District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan agreed.
segments.tr: Sparkle Sooknanan concordou.

segments.src: She found that the aggregation and disclosure of the data violated the Social Security Act, the Privacy Act, and the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: Ela concluiu que a agregação e divulgação dos dados violavam a Lei da Previdência Social, a Lei de Privacidade e a Lei de Procedimento Administrativo.

segments.src: She wrote that the government had "knowingly trampled on the privacy rights of American citizens in a manner that threatens the sacred right to vote," and she blocked the revised system.
segments.tr: Ela escreveu que o governo "pisoteou conscientemente os direitos de privacidade dos cidadãos americanos de uma maneira que ameaça o direito sagrado ao voto", e bloqueou o sistema revisado.

segments.src: The administration asked the Supreme Court to stay that order while the case continued.
segments.tr: O governo pediu à Suprema Corte que suspendesse essa ordem enquanto o caso continuava.

segments.src: ## Why the Majority Let SAVE Continue
segments.tr: ## Por que a maioria permitiu que o SAVE continuasse

segments.src: The Court's unsigned order said the voting-rights groups' claims about the legality of the modified system "likely lack merit," and that the Court was likely to reverse the district court's ruling.
segments.tr: A ordem não assinada da Corte afirmou que as alegações dos grupos de direitos de voto sobre a legalidade do sistema modificado "provavelmente carecem de mérito" e que a Corte provavelmente reverteria a decisão do tribunal distrital.

segments.src: It also said the federal government "has an obligation to respond to requests from state and local election officials seeking to verify the citizenship of voters."
segments.tr: Também afirmou que o governo federal "tem a obrigação de responder a solicitações de autoridades eleitorais estaduais e locais que buscam verificar a cidadania dos eleitores."

segments.src: Reporting on the order highlights two more points:
segments.tr: As reportagens sobre a ordem destacam mais dois pontos:

segments.src: 1. **Individualized checks.** The majority stressed the use of SAVE to check individual voters' citizenship as the election approaches.
segments.tr: 1. **Verificações individualizadas.** A maioria enfatizou o uso do SAVE para verificar a cidadania de eleitores individuais à medida que a eleição se aproxima.

segments.src: 2. **The 90-day rule.** Federal law generally bars systematic programs to remove voters from the rolls within 90 days of a federal election. That window is already open for the midterms. Reporters noted that this limits how the tool can be used before November.
segments.tr: 2. **A regra dos 90 dias.** A lei federal geralmente proíbe programas sistemáticos de remoção de eleitores das listas dentro de 90 dias antes de uma eleição federal. Essa janela já está aberta para as eleições de meio de mandato. Os repórteres observaram que isso limita como a ferramenta pode ser usada antes de novembro.

segments.src: In short, the majority signaled that officials may verify specific voters but should not run large-scale purges this close to the election.
segments.tr: Em suma, a maioria sinalizou que as autoridades podem verificar eleitores específicos, mas não devem realizar expurgos em larga escala tão perto da eleição.

in.title: 6-3 dan Basis Data Kewarganegaraan: Mengapa Mahkamah Agung Membiarkan Sistem SAVE Terus Memeriksa Daftar Pemilih Beberapa Minggu Sebelum Pemilu Sela

segments.src: On September 25, 2026, the Supreme Court granted an emergency request from the Justice Department and paused a lower-court order that had blocked the administration's overhauled SAVE system.
segments.tr: Pada 25 September 2026, Mahkamah Agung mengabulkan permohonan darurat dari Departemen Kehakiman dan menunda perintah pengadilan yang lebih rendah yang sebelumnya telah memblokir sistem SAVE yang telah dirombak oleh pemerintah.

segments.src: The vote was 6-3.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara berakhir dengan skor 6-3.

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3, less than six weeks away, the order lets federal agencies keep sharing citizenship data with state and local election officials who want to verify their voter lists.
segments.tr: Dengan Hari Pemilihan pada 3 November, yang tinggal kurang dari enam minggu lagi, perintah tersebut memungkinkan lembaga federal untuk terus membagikan data kewarganegaraan kepada pejabat pemilu negara bagian dan lokal yang ingin memverifikasi daftar pemilih mereka.

segments.src: The order is temporary and does not end the case.
segments.tr: Perintah tersebut bersifat sementara dan tidak mengakhiri kasus ini.

segments.src: Even so, it settles for now a question that has drawn attention from election officials, privacy advocates, and voting-rights groups: how far the federal government can go in helping states check who is a citizen.
segments.tr: Meskipun demikian, perintah ini untuk sementara menyelesaikan pertanyaan yang telah menarik perhatian dari pejabat pemilu, advokat privasi, dan kelompok hak pilih: seberapa jauh pemerintah federal dapat membantu negara bagian memeriksa siapa yang merupakan warga negara.

segments.src: ## What SAVE Is and What Changed
segments.tr: ## Apa Itu SAVE dan Apa yang Berubah

segments.src: SAVE stands for Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements.
segments.tr: SAVE adalah singkatan dari Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements (Verifikasi Orang Asing Sistematis untuk Hak-Hak).

segments.src: It is a federal data system that dates back to the 1980s.
segments.tr: Ini adalah sistem data federal yang sudah ada sejak tahun 1980-an.

segments.src: Government agencies originally used it to confirm the immigration status of people applying for public benefits or licenses.
segments.tr: Lembaga pemerintah awalnya menggunakannya untuk mengonfirmasi status imigrasi orang-orang yang mengajukan permohonan tunjangan publik atau lisensi.

segments.src: According to news reports, the Department of Homeland Security overhauled the system in 2025.
segments.tr: Menurut laporan berita, Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri merombak sistem tersebut pada tahun 2025.

segments.src: The changes:
segments.tr: Perubahannya:

segments.src: - **Broader data.** SAVE was linked for the first time with Social Security Administration records, which cover most Americans and not only noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Data yang lebih luas.** SAVE untuk pertama kalinya dihubungkan dengan catatan Administrasi Jaminan Sosial, yang mencakup sebagian besar orang Amerika dan bukan hanya bukan warga negara.

segments.src: - **Bulk searches.** States and localities can upload entire voter lists instead of checking one person at a time.
segments.tr: - **Pencarian massal.** Negara bagian dan pemerintah daerah dapat mengunggah seluruh daftar pemilih alih-alih memeriksa satu orang dalam satu waktu.

segments.src: - **A new use.** Election officials can run registered voters through the system to look for possible noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Penggunaan baru.** Pejabat pemilu dapat menjalankan daftar pemilih terdaftar melalui sistem untuk mencari kemungkinan bukan warga negara.

segments.src: NPR reported that 26 states had uploaded voter data and that the system had checked more than 65 million voters.
segments.tr: NPR melaporkan bahwa 26 negara bagian telah mengunggah data pemilih dan sistem tersebut telah memeriksa lebih dari 65 juta pemilih.

segments.src: About 28,635 were flagged as potential noncitizens.
segments.tr: Sekitar 28.635 orang ditandai sebagai kemungkinan bukan warga negara.

segments.src: A flag is not a finding.
segments.tr: Tanda (flag) bukanlah sebuah temuan.

segments.src: It is a lead that officials are expected to follow up, and in Texas, roughly one in five of 2,724 flagged voters was later confirmed to be a citizen and reinstated, according to the same reporting.
segments.tr: Itu adalah petunjuk yang diharapkan untuk ditindaklanjuti oleh para pejabat, dan di Texas, sekitar satu dari lima dari 2.724 pemilih yang ditandai kemudian dikonfirmasi sebagai warga negara dan dipulihkan haknya, menurut laporan yang sama.

segments.src: The government has not publicly released an overall error rate.
segments.tr: Pemerintah belum merilis tingkat kesalahan keseluruhan secara publik.

segments.src: ## How the Case Got to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Kasus Ini Sampai ke Mahkamah Agung

segments.src: The League of Women Voters, the Electronic Privacy Information Center, and five individuals sued the Department of Homeland Security, the Social Security Administration, and the Department of Justice.
segments.tr: League of Women Voters, Electronic Privacy Information Center, dan lima individu menggugat Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri, Administrasi Jaminan Sosial, dan Departemen Kehakiman.

segments.src: They argued that combining and sharing sensitive personal records this way broke federal law.
segments.tr: Mereka berpendapat bahwa menggabungkan dan membagikan catatan pribadi yang sensitif dengan cara ini melanggar hukum federal.

segments.src: In June 2026, U.S.
segments.tr: Pada Juni 2026, Hakim Distrik AS

segments.src: District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan agreed.
segments.tr: Sparkle Sooknanan setuju.

segments.src: She found that the aggregation and disclosure of the data violated the Social Security Act, the Privacy Act, and the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: Dia menemukan bahwa agregasi dan pengungkapan data tersebut melanggar Undang-Undang Jaminan Sosial, Undang-Undang Privasi, dan Undang-Undang Prosedur Administratif.

segments.src: She wrote that the government had "knowingly trampled on the privacy rights of American citizens in a manner that threatens the sacred right to vote," and she blocked the revised system.
segments.tr: Dia menulis bahwa pemerintah telah "secara sadar menginjak-injak hak privasi warga negara Amerika dengan cara yang mengancam hak suci untuk memilih," dan dia memblokir sistem yang direvisi tersebut.

segments.src: The administration asked the Supreme Court to stay that order while the case continued.
segments.tr: Pemerintah meminta Mahkamah Agung untuk menunda perintah tersebut sementara kasus berlanjut.

segments.src: ## Why the Majority Let SAVE Continue
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Mayoritas Membiarkan SAVE Berlanjut

segments.src: The Court's unsigned order said the voting-rights groups' claims about the legality of the modified system "likely lack merit," and that the Court was likely to reverse the district court's ruling.
segments.tr: Perintah Mahkamah yang tidak ditandatangani menyatakan bahwa klaim kelompok hak pilih mengenai legalitas sistem yang dimodifikasi "kemungkinan tidak memiliki dasar," dan bahwa Mahkamah kemungkinan akan membatalkan putusan pengadilan distrik.

segments.src: It also said the federal government "has an obligation to respond to requests from state and local election officials seeking to verify the citizenship of voters."
segments.tr: Perintah itu juga menyatakan bahwa pemerintah federal "memiliki kewajiban untuk menanggapi permintaan dari pejabat pemilu negara bagian dan lokal yang ingin memverifikasi kewarganegaraan pemilih."

segments.src: Reporting on the order highlights two more points:
segments.tr: Laporan mengenai perintah tersebut menyoroti dua poin lagi:

segments.src: 1. **Individualized checks.** The majority stressed the use of SAVE to check individual voters' citizenship as the election approaches.
segments.tr: 1. **Pemeriksaan individual.** Mayoritas menekankan penggunaan SAVE untuk memeriksa kewarganegaraan pemilih secara individu saat pemilihan mendekat.

segments.src: 2. **The 90-day rule.** Federal law generally bars systematic programs to remove voters from the rolls within 90 days of a federal election. That window is already open for the midterms. Reporters noted that this limits how the tool can be used before November.
segments.tr: 2. **Aturan 90 hari.** Hukum federal umumnya melarang program sistematis untuk menghapus pemilih dari daftar dalam waktu 90 hari sebelum pemilihan federal. Jendela waktu tersebut sudah terbuka untuk pemilu sela. Wartawan mencatat bahwa ini membatasi bagaimana alat tersebut dapat digunakan sebelum November.

segments.src: In short, the majority signaled that officials may verify specific voters but should not run large-scale purges this close to the election.
segments.tr: Singkatnya, mayoritas memberi isyarat bahwa pejabat dapat memverifikasi pemilih tertentu tetapi tidak boleh melakukan pembersihan skala besar sedekat ini dengan pemilihan.

segments.src: ## Jackson's Dissent
segments.tr: ## Pendapat Berbeda Jackson

segments.src: Justices Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, and Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented.
segments.tr: Hakim Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, dan Ketanji Brown Jackson menyatakan pendapat berbeda (dissent).

segments.src: Jackson wrote the dissent.
segments.tr: Jackson menulis pendapat berbeda tersebut.

segments.src: She faulted the majority for not weighing the harms that could follow if the modified system keeps operating.
segments.tr: Dia menyalahkan mayoritas karena tidak mempertimbangkan kerugian yang dapat terjadi jika sistem yang dimodifikasi terus beroperasi.

segments.src: One risk she named was that states might cancel the registrations of at least some recently naturalized citizens, or make them show proof of citizenship before voting.
segments.tr: Salah satu risiko yang dia sebutkan adalah bahwa negara bagian mungkin membatalkan pendaftaran setidaknya beberapa warga negara yang baru dinaturalisasi, atau membuat mereka menunjukkan bukti kewarganegaraan sebelum memilih.

segments.src: Her central argument was about how to weigh the two sides:
segments.tr: Argumen utamanya adalah tentang bagaimana menimbang kedua belah pihak:

segments.src: > "[T]he harm caused by burdening or disenfranchising even a few lawful voters outweighs the nonexistent harm that the Government experiences when it is prevented from taking an action that it likely lacks the authority to take."
segments.tr: > "[K]erugian yang disebabkan oleh pembebanan atau pencabutan hak pilih bahkan bagi beberapa pemilih yang sah lebih besar daripada kerugian yang tidak ada yang dialami Pemerintah ketika dicegah untuk mengambil tindakan yang kemungkinan besar tidak memiliki wewenang untuk diambil."

segments.src: Coverage of the dissent also noted her objection that the Court acted on its emergency docket without full briefing or oral argument.
segments.tr: Liputan tentang pendapat berbeda tersebut juga mencatat keberatannya bahwa Mahkamah bertindak pada daftar daruratnya tanpa pengarahan penuh atau argumen lisan.

segments.src: ## The Two Sides in Plain Terms
segments.tr: ## Dua Sisi dalam Istilah Sederhana

segments.src: **Supporters of the decision** say election officials need reliable tools to keep voter rolls accurate.
segments.tr: **Pendukung keputusan** mengatakan pejabat pemilu membutuhkan alat yang andal untuk menjaga daftar pemilih tetap akurat.

segments.src: They say the federal government holds data states cannot easily get elsewhere, and that Congress and the Court have treated accurate rolls as a legitimate goal.
segments.tr: Mereka mengatakan pemerintah federal memegang data yang tidak mudah didapatkan negara bagian di tempat lain, dan bahwa Kongres serta Mahkamah telah memperlakukan daftar pemilih yang akurat sebagai tujuan yang sah.

segments.src: Noncitizen voting is illegal under federal law, and supporters argue that verification protects public confidence in elections.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara oleh bukan warga negara adalah ilegal menurut hukum federal, dan pendukung berpendapat bahwa verifikasi melindungi kepercayaan publik terhadap pemilu.

segments.src: **Critics** say the system can wrongly flag eligible voters.
segments.tr: **Kritikus** mengatakan sistem tersebut dapat secara keliru menandai pemilih yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: Naturalized citizens, whose records may not match every federal database, are the group most often cited.
segments.tr: Warga negara naturalisasi, yang catatannya mungkin tidak cocok dengan setiap basis data federal, adalah kelompok yang paling sering dikutip.

segments.src: They also worry about privacy when Social Security data is used for a purpose it was not built for, and about mistakes that come too late for a voter to fix before Election Day.
segments.tr: Mereka juga khawatir tentang privasi ketika data Jaminan Sosial digunakan untuk tujuan yang tidak dibangun untuk itu, dan tentang kesalahan yang datang terlambat bagi pemilih untuk diperbaiki sebelum Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: Both concerns are recognized in the order itself.
segments.tr: Kedua kekhawatiran tersebut diakui dalam perintah itu sendiri.

segments.src: The majority points to the 90-day limit and to individualized review.
segments.tr: Mayoritas menunjuk pada batas 90 hari dan pada tinjauan individual.

segments.src: The dissent points to the risk that errors reach real voters.
segments.tr: Pendapat berbeda menunjuk pada risiko bahwa kesalahan mencapai pemilih yang sebenarnya.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: - **The case continues.** A stay pauses the lower court's order but is not a final ruling on the merits. The litigation over the system's legality goes on.
segments.tr: - **Kasus berlanjut.** Penundaan menghentikan perintah pengadilan yang lebih rendah tetapi bukan putusan akhir mengenai substansi. Litigasi mengenai legalitas sistem terus berlanjut.

segments.src: - **State practices will vary.** Each state decides whether and how to use SAVE and what follow-up process applies to flagged voters.
segments.tr: - **Praktik negara bagian akan bervariasi.** Setiap negara bagian memutuskan apakah dan bagaimana menggunakan SAVE dan proses tindak lanjut apa yang berlaku untuk pemilih yang ditandai.

segments.src: - **Timing matters.** With less than six weeks to Election Day, any verification step that leads to a registration problem leaves little time to correct it.
segments.tr: - **Waktu itu penting.** Dengan kurang dari enam minggu menuju Hari Pemilihan, setiap langkah verifikasi yang mengarah pada masalah pendaftaran menyisakan sedikit waktu untuk memperbaikinya.

segments.src: ## What Voters Can Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dapat Dilakukan Pemilih

segments.src: Nothing in the order changes who is eligible to vote or the basic rules for casting a ballot.
segments.tr: Tidak ada dalam perintah tersebut yang mengubah siapa yang memenuhi syarat untuk memilih atau aturan dasar untuk memberikan suara.

segments.src: A few practical steps are worth taking whatever your view of the ruling:
segments.tr: Beberapa langkah praktis layak diambil apa pun pandangan Anda tentang putusan tersebut:

segments.src: - **Check your registration** on your state or local election office's official website.
segments.tr: - **Periksa pendaftaran Anda** di situs web resmi kantor pemilu negara bagian atau lokal Anda.

segments.src: - **Respond promptly** if you receive a notice asking you to confirm your eligibility or citizenship. Keep any documents the notice asks for.
segments.tr: - **Tanggapi dengan segera** jika Anda menerima pemberitahuan yang meminta Anda untuk mengonfirmasi kelayakan atau kewarganegaraan Anda. Simpan dokumen apa pun yang diminta oleh pemberitahuan tersebut.

segments.src: - **Contact your local election office** if you believe your record is wrong. It can explain the correction process and deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Hubungi kantor pemilu lokal Anda** jika Anda yakin catatan Anda salah. Mereka dapat menjelaskan proses koreksi dan tenggat waktunya.

segments.src: - **Confirm key dates** for registration, early voting, and mail ballots with official state sources.
segments.tr: - **Konfirmasi tanggal penting** untuk pendaftaran, pemungutan suara awal, dan surat suara melalui pos dengan sumber resmi negara bagian.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The Supreme Court's 6-3 order keeps a revised federal citizenship-verification system running during the final weeks before the midterms.
segments.tr: Perintah 6-3 Mahkamah Agung menjaga sistem verifikasi kewarganegaraan federal yang direvisi tetap berjalan selama minggu-minggu terakhir sebelum pemilu sela.

segments.src: The majority views the legal challenge as unlikely to succeed and stresses individualized checks.
segments.tr: Mayoritas memandang tantangan hukum tersebut tidak mungkin berhasil dan menekankan pemeriksaan individual.

segments.src: The dissenters warn that even a small number of wrongly burdened voters is too high a cost.
segments.tr: Mereka yang berbeda pendapat memperingatkan bahwa bahkan sejumlah kecil pemilih yang terbebani secara keliru adalah biaya yang terlalu tinggi.

segments.src: The case is not over.
segments.tr: Kasus ini belum berakhir.

segments.src: In the meantime, voters and election officials will work under the order's limits, including the 90-day rule on systematic removals.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, pemilih dan pejabat pemilu akan bekerja di bawah batasan perintah tersebut, termasuk aturan 90 hari tentang penghapusan sistematis.

segments.src: ## What SAVE Is and What Changed
segments.tr: ## SAVEとは何か、何が変更されたのか

segments.src: SAVE stands for Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements.
segments.tr: SAVEとは、Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements（給付金のための系統的外国人確認）の略称である。

segments.tr: 政府機関は元々、公的給付やライセンスを申請する人々の移民ステータスを確認するためにこれを使用していた。

segments.src: According to news reports, the Department of Homeland Security overhauled the system in 2025.

segments.src: The changes:

segments.src: - **Broader data.** SAVE was linked for the first time with Social Security Administration records, which cover most Americans and not only noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **データの拡大。** SAVEは今回初めて社会保障庁の記録と連携され、非市民だけでなくほとんどのアメリカ人が対象となった。

segments.src: - **Bulk searches.** States and localities can upload entire voter lists instead of checking one person at a time.
segments.tr: - **一括検索。** 州や地方自治体は、1人ずつ確認するのではなく、有権者名簿全体をアップロードできるようになった。

segments.src: - **A new use.** Election officials can run registered voters through the system to look for possible noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **新しい用途。** 選挙管理官は、登録有権者をシステムに通して非市民の可能性がないか調べることができる。

segments.src: NPR reported that 26 states had uploaded voter data and that the system had checked more than 65 million voters.
segments.tr: NPRの報道によると、26の州が有権者データをアップロードし、システムは6,500万人以上の有権者をチェックした。

segments.src: About 28,635 were flagged as potential noncitizens.
segments.tr: 約28,635人が潜在的な非市民としてフラグが付けられた。

segments.src: A flag is not a finding.
segments.tr: フラグは確定結果ではない。

segments.src: It is a lead that officials are expected to follow up, and in Texas, roughly one in five of 2,724 flagged voters was later confirmed to be a citizen and reinstated, according to the same reporting.
segments.tr: それは当局が調査すべき手がかりであり、同じ報道によれば、テキサス州ではフラグが付けられた2,724人の有権者のうちおよそ5人に1人が後に市民であることが確認され、登録が復元された。

segments.src: The government has not publicly released an overall error rate.
segments.tr: 政府は全体のエラー率を公表していない。

segments.src: ## How the Case Got to the Supreme Court
segments.tr: ## 裁判が最高裁に持ち込まれた経緯

segments.src: The League of Women Voters, the Electronic Privacy Information Center, and five individuals sued the Department of Homeland Security, the Social Security Administration, and the Department of Justice.
segments.tr: 全米女性有権者連盟（League of Women Voters）、電子プライバシー情報センター（EPIC）、および5人の個人が、国土安全保障省、社会保障庁、司法省を提訴した。

segments.src: They argued that combining and sharing sensitive personal records this way broke federal law.
segments.tr: 彼らは、このように機密性の高い個人記録を統合して共有することは連邦法に違反すると主張した。

segments.src: In June 2026, U.S.
segments.tr: 2026年6月、米国の

segments.src: District Judge Sparkle Sooknanan agreed.
segments.tr: スパークル・スークナナン連邦地裁判事がそれに同意した。

segments.src: She found that the aggregation and disclosure of the data violated the Social Security Act, the Privacy Act, and the Administrative Procedure Act.
segments.tr: 彼女は、データの集約と開示が社会保障法、プライバシー法、および行政手続法に違反しているとの判断を下した。

segments.src: She wrote that the government had "knowingly trampled on the privacy rights of American citizens in a manner that threatens the sacred right to vote," and she blocked the revised system.
segments.tr: 彼女は、政府が「神聖な投票権を脅かす方法で、アメリカ市民のプライバシー権を意図的に踏みにじった」と書き記し、改定されたシステムを差し止めた。

segments.src: The administration asked the Supreme Court to stay that order while the case continued.
segments.tr: 政権側は最高裁に対し、訴訟が継続する間その命令の執行停止を求めた。

segments.src: ## Why the Majority Let SAVE Continue
segments.tr: ## 多数派がSAVEの継続を認めた理由

segments.src: The Court's unsigned order said the voting-rights groups' claims about the legality of the modified system "likely lack merit," and that the Court was likely to reverse the district court's ruling.
segments.tr: 裁判所の署名のない命令は、修正されたシステムの合法性に関する投票権団体の主張は「おそらく根拠に欠けており」、最高裁は地裁の判決を覆す可能性が高いと述べた。

segments.src: It also said the federal government "has an obligation to respond to requests from state and local election officials seeking to verify the citizenship of voters."
segments.tr: また、連邦政府には「有権者の市民権を確認しようとする州および地方の選挙管理官からの要請に応じる義務がある」とも述べた。

segments.src: Reporting on the order highlights two more points:
segments.tr: この命令に関する報道では、さらに2つの点が強調されている：

segments.src: 1. **Individualized checks.** The majority stressed the use of SAVE to check individual voters' citizenship as the election approaches.
segments.tr: 1. **個別の確認。** 多数派は、選挙が近づく中での個別有権者の市民権確認のためのSAVEの使用を強調した。

segments.src: 2. **The 90-day rule.** Federal law generally bars systematic programs to remove voters from the rolls within 90 days of a federal election. That window is already open for the midterms. Reporters noted that this limits how the tool can be used before November.
segments.tr: 2. **90日ルール。** 連邦法は一般的に、連邦選挙の90日前以内に名簿から有権者を削除する組織的プログラムを禁止している。中間選挙に向けてすでにその期間に入っている。記者らは、これが11月前にツールの使用方法を制限するものであると指摘した。

segments.src: In short, the majority signaled that officials may verify specific voters but should not run large-scale purges this close to the election.
segments.tr: 要するに、多数派は、当局が特定の有権者を確認することは許可されるが、選挙間近に大規模な排除を行うべきではないというシグナルを送った。

segments.src: ## Jackson's Dissent
segments.tr: ## ジャクソン判事の反対意見

segments.src: Justices Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, and Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented.
segments.tr: ソニア・ソトマイヨール、エレナ・ケイガン、ケタンジ・ブラウン・ジャクソンの各判事が反対意見を表明した。

segments.src: Jackson wrote the dissent.
segments.tr: ジャクソン判事が反対意見を執筆した。

segments.src: She faulted the majority for not weighing the harms that could follow if the modified system keeps operating.
segments.tr: 彼女は、修正されたシステムが稼働し続けた場合に生じ得る害悪を多数派が衡量しなかったことを批判した。

segments.src: One risk she named was that states might cancel the registrations of at least some recently naturalized citizens, or make them show proof of citizenship before voting.
segments.tr: 彼女が挙げたリスクの一つは、州が最近帰化市民になった人々の少なくとも一部の登録を取り消したり、投票前に市民権の証明を示させたりする可能性があるというものであった。

segments.src: Her central argument was about how to weigh the two sides:
segments.tr: 彼女の中心的な論点は、両者をどのように比較衡量するかという点であった：

segments.src: > "[T]he harm caused by burdening or disenfranchising even a few lawful voters outweighs the nonexistent harm that the Government experiences when it is prevented from taking an action that it likely lacks the authority to take."
segments.tr: > 「[我々は次のように考える。]わずかな合法的な有権者に負担をかけたり参政権を奪ったりすることによって引き起こされる害悪は、政府が権限を持たない可能性が高い行動をとることを阻止された場合に受ける存在しない害悪をはるかに上回る。」

segments.src: Coverage of the dissent also noted her objection that the Court acted on its emergency docket without full briefing or oral argument.
segments.tr: 反対意見に関する報道では、裁判所が十分なブリーフィングや口頭弁論なしに緊急ドケットで行動したことに対する彼女の異議も指摘された。

segments.src: ## The Two Sides in Plain Terms
segments.tr: ## 双方の主張の平易な解説

segments.src: **Supporters of the decision** say election officials need reliable tools to keep voter rolls accurate.
segments.tr: **決定の支持者**は、有権者名簿の正確性を保つために選挙管理官には信頼できるツールが必要であると述べている。

segments.src: They say the federal government holds data states cannot easily get elsewhere, and that Congress and the Court have treated accurate rolls as a legitimate goal.
segments.tr: 彼らは、連邦政府は州が他で容易に入手できないデータを保持しており、議会と最高裁は正確な名簿を正当な目的として扱ってきたと主張している。

segments.src: Noncitizen voting is illegal under federal law, and supporters argue that verification protects public confidence in elections.
segments.tr: 非市民の投票は連邦法のもとでは違法であり、支持者らは確認作業が選挙に対する国民の信頼を守ると主張している。

segments.src: **Critics** say the system can wrongly flag eligible voters.
segments.tr: **批判派**は、このシステムが適格な有権者に誤ってフラグを立てる可能性があると述べている。

segments.src: Naturalized citizens, whose records may not match every federal database, are the group most often cited.
segments.tr: 記録がすべての連邦データベースと一致しない可能性がある帰化市民は、最も頻繁に挙げられるグループである。

segments.src: They also worry about privacy when Social Security data is used for a purpose it was not built for, and about mistakes that come too late for a voter to fix before Election Day.
segments.tr: また彼らは、社会保障データが本来の目的とは異なる用途に使用された場合のプライバシーや、有権者が投票日前に修正するには手遅れになるようなミスについて懸念している。

segments.src: Both concerns are recognized in the order itself.
segments.tr: 双方の懸念は命令自体の中で認められている。

segments.src: The majority points to the 90-day limit and to individualized review.
segments.tr: 多数派は90日間の制限と個別審査を指摘している。

segments.src: The dissent points to the risk that errors reach real voters.
segments.tr: 反対意見は、エラーが実際の有権者に及ぶリスクを指摘している。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起きるか

segments.src: - **The case continues.** A stay pauses the lower court's order but is not a final ruling on the merits. The litigation over the system's legality goes on.
segments.tr: - **裁判の継続。** 執行停止は下級審の命令を一時停止するものであり、本案に関する最終的な判決ではない。システムの合法性をめぐる訴訟は継続する。

segments.src: - **State practices will vary.** Each state decides whether and how to use SAVE and what follow-up process applies to flagged voters.
segments.tr: - **州の対応の多様性。** 各州がSAVEを使用するかどうか、どのように使用するか、またフラグが立てられた有権者にどのようなフォローアッププロセスを適用するかを決定する。

segments.src: - **Timing matters.** With less than six weeks to Election Day, any verification step that leads to a registration problem leaves little time to correct it.
segments.tr: - **タイミングの重要性。** 投票日まで6週間を切る中、登録上の問題につながる確認ステップは、それを修正する時間をほとんど残さない。

segments.src: ## What Voters Can Do
segments.tr: ## 有権者ができること

segments.src: Nothing in the order changes who is eligible to vote or the basic rules for casting a ballot.
segments.tr: この命令のいかなる部分も、誰が投票資格を持っているか、あるいは投票用紙を投じるための基本ルールを変更するものではない。

segments.src: A few practical steps are worth taking whatever your view of the ruling:
segments.tr: 判決に対する見解にかかわらず、いくつかの実用的なステップを踏む価値がある：

segments.src: - **Check your registration** on your state or local election office's official website.
segments.tr: - **登録の確認** 州または地方の選挙管理事務所の公式ウェブサイトで登録を確認する。

segments.src: - **Respond promptly** if you receive a notice asking you to confirm your eligibility or citizenship. Keep any documents the notice asks for.
segments.tr: - **迅速な対応** 資格や市民権の確認を求める通知を受け取った場合は、速やかに応答する。通知が要求する書類は保管しておく。

segments.src: - **Contact your local election office** if you believe your record is wrong. It can explain the correction process and deadlines.
segments.tr: - **選挙管理事務所への連絡** 自分の記録が間違っていると思われる場合は、地元の選挙管理事務所に連絡する。修正プロセスや締め切りについて説明を受けることができる。

segments.src: - **Confirm key dates** for registration, early voting, and mail ballots with official state sources.
segments.tr: - **重要日程の確認** 登録、期日前投票、郵送投票の重要な日程を公式の州の情報源で確認する。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The Supreme Court's 6-3 order keeps a revised federal citizenship-verification system running during the final weeks before the midterms.
segments.tr: 最高裁の6対3の命令により、改定された連邦の市民権確認システムは、中間選挙直前の数週間も稼働し続けることになった。

segments.src: The majority views the legal challenge as unlikely to succeed and stresses individualized checks.
segments.tr: 多数派は法的異議申し立てが成功する可能性は低いと見なし、個別の確認を強調している。

segments.src: The dissenters warn that even a small number of wrongly burdened voters is too high a cost.
segments.tr: 反対派は、たとえ少数の誤った負担をかけられた有権者であっても、それは大きすぎる代償であると警告している。

segments.src: The case is not over.
segments.tr: 裁判はまだ終わっていない。

segments.src: In the meantime, voters and election officials will work under the order's limits, including the 90-day rule on systematic removals.
segments.tr: その間、有権者と選挙管理官は、組織的排除に関する90日ルールを含め、命令の制限のもとで作業を行うことになる。

segments.src: ## What SAVE Is and What Changed
segments.tr: ## Was SAVE ist und was sich geändert hat

segments.src: SAVE stands for Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements.
segments.tr: SAVE steht für Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements.

segments.src: It is a federal data system that dates back to the 1980s.
segments.tr: Es ist ein bundesweites Datensystem, das aus den 1980er Jahren stammt.

segments.src: Government agencies originally used it to confirm the immigration status of people applying for public benefits or licenses.
segments.tr: Regierungsbehörden nutzten es ursprünglich, um den Einwanderungsstatus von Personen zu bestätigen, die öffentliche Leistungen oder Lizenzen beantragen.

segments.src: According to news reports, the Department of Homeland Security overhauled the system in 2025.
segments.tr: Berichten zufolge hat das Heimatschutzministerium das System im Jahr 2025 überarbeitet.

segments.src: The changes:
segments.tr: Die Änderungen:

segments.src: - **Broader data.** SAVE was linked for the first time with Social Security Administration records, which cover most Americans and not only noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Breitere Daten.** SAVE wurde erstmals mit den Aufzeichnungen der Sozialversicherungsbehörde verknüpft, die die meisten Amerikaner und nicht nur Nichtbürger abdecken.

segments.src: - **Bulk searches.** States and localities can upload entire voter lists instead of checking one person at a time.
segments.tr: - **Massenabfragen.** Bundesstaaten und Kommunen können ganze Wählerverzeichnisse hochladen, anstatt eine Person nach der anderen zu überprüfen.

segments.src: - **A new use.** Election officials can run registered voters through the system to look for possible noncitizens.
segments.tr: - **Eine neue Verwendung.** Wahlbeamte können registrierte Wähler durch das System laufen lassen, um nach möglichen Nichtbürgern zu suchen.

segments.tr: NPR berichtete, dass 26 Bundesstaaten Wählerdaten hochgeladen hatten und dass das System mehr als 65 Millionen Wähler überprüft hatte.

segments.src: About 28,635 were flagged as potential noncitizens.
segments.tr: Etwa 28.635 wurden als potenzielle Nichtbürger markiert.

segments.src: A flag is not a finding.
segments.tr: Eine Markierung ist kein Befund.

segments.tr: 2. **Die 90-Tage-Regel.** Bundesrecht verbietet im Allgemeinen systematische Programme zur Streichung von Wählern aus den Verzeichnissen innerhalb von 90 Tagen vor einer Bundeswahl. Dieses Zeitfenster ist für die Zwischenwahlen bereits geöffnet. Reporter wiesen darauf hin, dass dies einschränkt, wie das Werkzeug vor November genutzt werden kann.

segments.src: In short, the majority signaled that officials may verify specific voters but should not run large-scale purges this close to the election.
segments.tr: Kurz gesagt signalisierte die Mehrheit, dass Beamte bestimmte Wähler überprüfen dürfen, aber keine groß angelegten Säuberungen so kurz vor der Wahl durchführen sollten.

segments.src: ## Jackson's Dissent
segments.tr: ## Jacksons abweichende Meinung

segments.src: Justices Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, and Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented.
segments.tr: Die Richter Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan und Ketanji Brown Jackson stimmten dagegen.

segments.src: Jackson wrote the dissent.
segments.tr: Jackson verfasste die abweichende Meinung.

segments.src: She faulted the majority for not weighing the harms that could follow if the modified system keeps operating.
segments.tr: Sie warf der Mehrheit vor, die Schäden nicht abzuwägen, die entstehen könnten, wenn das modifizierte System weiter betrieben wird.

segments.src: One risk she named was that states might cancel the registrations of at least some recently naturalized citizens, or make them show proof of citizenship before voting.
segments.tr: Ein von ihr genanntes Risiko war, dass Bundesstaaten die Registrierungen von mindestens einigen kürzlich eingebürgerten Bürgern streichen oder sie vor der Stimmabgabe einen Nachweis der Staatsbürgerschaft erbringen lassen könnten.

segments.src: Her central argument was about how to weigh the two sides:
segments.tr: Ihr zentrales Argument drehte sich darum, wie die beiden Seiten gegeneinander abzuwägen sind:

segments.src: > "[T]he harm caused by burdening or disenfranchising even a few lawful voters outweighs the nonexistent harm that the Government experiences when it is prevented from taking an action that it likely lacks the authority to take."
segments.tr: > „[Der] Schaden, der durch die Belastung oder Entziehung des Wahlrechts selbst weniger rechtmäßiger Wähler verursacht wird, überwiegt den nichtexistenten Schaden, den die Regierung erleidet, wenn sie daran gehindert wird, eine Handlung vorzunehmen, für deren Durchführung ihr wahrscheinlich die Befugnis fehlt.“

segments.src: Coverage of the dissent also noted her objection that the Court acted on its emergency docket without full briefing or oral argument.
segments.tr: Die Berichterstattung über die abweichende Meinung wies auch auf ihren Einwand hin, dass das Gericht auf seiner Notfalldokumentenliste ohne vollständige Schriftsätze oder mündliche Verhandlung gehandelt habe.

segments.src: ## The Two Sides in Plain Terms
segments.tr: ## Die beiden Seiten in einfachen Worten

segments.src: **Supporters of the decision** say election officials need reliable tools to keep voter rolls accurate.
segments.tr: **Befürworter der Entscheidung** sagen, Wahlbeamte bräuchten verlässliche Werkzeuge, um Wählerverzeichnisse korrekt zu halten.

segments.src: They say the federal government holds data states cannot easily get elsewhere, and that Congress and the Court have treated accurate rolls as a legitimate goal.
segments.tr: Sie sagen, die Bundesregierung verfüge über Daten, die Bundesstaaten anderswo nicht leicht bekommen können, und dass Kongress und Gericht genaue Verzeichnisse als legitimes Ziel behandelt hätten.

segments.src: Noncitizen voting is illegal under federal law, and supporters argue that verification protects public confidence in elections.
segments.tr: Die Stimmabgabe von Nichtbürgern ist nach Bundesrecht illegal, und Befürworter argumentieren, dass die Überprüfung das öffentliche Vertrauen in Wahlen schützt.

segments.src: **Critics** say the system can wrongly flag eligible voters.
segments.tr: **Kritiker** sagen, das System könne wahlberechtigte Wähler zu Unrecht markieren.

segments.src: Naturalized citizens, whose records may not match every federal database, are the group most often cited.
segments.tr: Eingebürgerte Bürger, deren Aufzeichnungen möglicherweise nicht mit jeder Bundesdatenbank übereinstimmen, sind die am häufigsten genannte Gruppe.

segments.src: They also worry about privacy when Social Security data is used for a purpose it was not built for, and about mistakes that come too late for a voter to fix before Election Day.
segments.tr: Sie machen sich auch Sorgen um den Datenschutz, wenn Sozialversicherungsdaten für einen Zweck verwendet werden, für den sie nicht entwickelt wurden, und um Fehler, die zu spät kommen, als dass ein Wähler sie vor dem Wahltag korrigieren könnte.

segments.src: Both concerns are recognized in the order itself.
segments.tr: Beide Bedenken werden in der Anordnung selbst anerkannt.

segments.src: The majority points to the 90-day limit and to individualized review.
segments.tr: Die Mehrheit verweist auf das 90-Tage-Limit und auf die individualisierte Überprüfung.

segments.src: The dissent points to the risk that errors reach real voters.
segments.tr: Die abweichende Meinung verweist auf das Risiko, dass Fehler echte Wähler erreichen.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes passiert

segments.src: - **The case continues.** A stay pauses the lower court's order but is not a final ruling on the merits. The litigation over the system's legality goes on.
segments.tr: - **Der Fall geht weiter.** Eine Aussetzung pausiert die Entscheidung des unteren Gerichts, ist aber keine endgültige Entscheidung in der Sache. Der Rechtsstreit über die Legalität des Systems geht weiter.

segments.src: - **State practices will vary.** Each state decides whether and how to use SAVE and what follow-up process applies to flagged voters.
segments.tr: - **Die Praktiken der Bundesstaaten werden variieren.** Jeder Bundesstaat entscheidet, ob und wie er SAVE nutzt und welcher Nachbereitungsprozess für markierte Wähler gilt.

segments.src: - **Timing matters.** With less than six weeks to Election Day, any verification step that leads to a registration problem leaves little time to correct it.
segments.tr: - **Das Timing zählt.** Mit weniger als sechs Wochen bis zum Wahltag lässt jeder Überprüfungsschritt, der zu einem Registrierungsproblem führt, wenig Zeit, um es zu korrigieren.

segments.src: ## What Voters Can Do
segments.tr: ## Was Wähler tun können

segments.src: Nothing in the order changes who is eligible to vote or the basic rules for casting a ballot.
segments.tr: Nichts in der Anordnung ändert daran, wer wahlberechtigt ist oder an den grundlegenden Regeln für die Stimmabgabe.

segments.src: A few practical steps are worth taking whatever your view of the ruling:
segments.tr: Ein paar praktische Schritte lohnen sich, unabhängig von Ihrer Sichtweise auf das Urteil:

segments.src: - **Check your registration** on your state or local election office's official website.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie Ihre Registrierung** auf der offiziellen Website Ihres staatlichen oder lokalen Wahlbüros.

segments.src: - **Respond promptly** if you receive a notice asking you to confirm your eligibility or citizenship. Keep any documents the notice asks for.
segments.tr: - **Antworten Sie umgehend**, wenn Sie eine Benachrichtigung erhalten, in der Sie aufgefordert werden, Ihre Berechtigung oder Staatsbürgerschaft zu bestätigen. Bewahren Sie alle Dokumente auf, nach denen die Benachrichtigung fragt.

segments.src: - **Contact your local election office** if you believe your record is wrong. It can explain the correction process and deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Kontaktieren Sie Ihr lokales Wahlbüro**, wenn Sie glauben, dass Ihr Eintrag falsch ist. Es kann den Korrekturprozess und Fristen erklären.

segments.src: - **Confirm key dates** for registration, early voting, and mail ballots with official state sources.
segments.tr: - **Bestätigen Sie wichtige Daten** für die Registrierung, die Briefwahl und Briefwahlunterlagen mit offiziellen staatlichen Quellen.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The Supreme Court's 6-3 order keeps a revised federal citizenship-verification system running during the final weeks before the midterms.
segments.tr: Die 6-3-Entscheidung des Obersten Gerichtshofs hält ein überarbeitetes föderales System zur Überprüfung der Staatsbürgerschaft in den letzten Wochen vor den Zwischenwahlen am Laufen.

segments.src: The majority views the legal challenge as unlikely to succeed and stresses individualized checks.
segments.tr: Die Mehrheit sieht die rechtliche Anfechtung als unwahrscheinlich an, dass sie Erfolg hat, und betont individualisierte Überprüfungen.

segments.src: The dissenters warn that even a small number of wrongly burdened voters is too high a cost.
segments.tr: Die Dissidenten warnen, dass selbst eine kleine Anzahl zu Unrecht belasteter Wähler ein zu hoher Preis ist.

segments.src: The case is not over.
segments.tr: Der Fall ist nicht vorbei.

segments.src: In the meantime, voters and election officials will work under the order's limits, including the 90-day rule on systematic removals.
segments.tr: In der Zwischenzeit werden Wähler und Wahlbeamte unter den Grenzen der Anordnung arbeiten, einschließlich der 90-Tage-Regel für systematische Entfernungen.
